summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything I read the full path end-to-end (client `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx` routing, `api.ts`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `schema.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `db/index.ts`, CORS config) rather than assuming the ticket's hypothesis. Notably:  - **Server side looks correctly scoped.** `watchlists.user_id` is `NOT NULL`; every GET/POST/PUT/DELETE in `handlers.ts` filters or ownership-checks by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. Auth middleware (`handlers.ts:13-21`)
